answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. The glacier is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nadir.
